meditate: Somewhere in the second hour the breath stopped being something you did.
A bird landed on your knee and stayed a while.
train: You ran the same form until your feet stopped asking where to go.
A child watched you practise, then copied you badly, then less badly.
gather: You found a patch nobody had picked in years.
Rain came; you sheltered under a ledge and sorted what you had.
craft: The bench found its rhythm and you followed it.
You ruined one, swore, and the next came out better for it.
